title: A Signal for the Vector
author: Ines Galloway
blurb: Astrid Yarrow, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
